TestRebuild::test_simple_rebuild.description: 1 node in dc1 (ks NTS dc1:1, 25 keys / 10 in debug), add node2 in dc2, ALTER ks to dc1:1,dc2:1, run `nodetool rebuild dc1` on node2, then read all keys at CL=ALL. TestRebuild::test_simple_rebuild.reason: Bug: test cannot detect a broken rebuild - NodetoolError is caught and counted in rebuild_errors/unexpected_errors (rebuild_test.py:89-104) but the asserts were removed in 4b23df18a6, and the final check reads at CL=ALL with node1 (source) alive (rebuild_test.py:110-111), which returns the row even if node2 has nothing. Candidate RED: test_rebuild_everywhere covers the same cross-dc rebuild with a real per-node check; alternatively fix (re-add assert, read node2 alone/LOCAL_ONE in dc2). Note: comments say auto_bootstrap: false but 0619a308ef dropped it; docstring CASSANDRA-9119 refers to removed check; skip mark refs closed #23525; rebuild is a no-op for tablet ks. Note (class): cluster_options start_rpc=true is dead config (scylla db/config.cc:1288 value_status::Unused). Bug (class): fixture sets allow_log_errors=True (rebuild_test.py:32), so ERROR log lines never fail any test.
